wern_q3_2026.text: EX-99.1 2 wern-2026x930xex991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Werner Enterprises Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results Third Quarter 2026 Highlights (all metrics compared to third quarter 2025 ) • Total revenues of $950.5 million, increased $179.0 million, or 23% • Operating income of $17.0 million compared to an operating loss of $13.0 million in the prior year; non-GAAP adjusted operating income of $21.0 million, increased $10.1 million, or 92% • Operating margin of 1.8%, increased 350 basis points from (1.7)%; non-GAAP adjusted operating margin of 2.2%, increased 80 basis points from 1.4% • Diluted earnings per share of $0.11 compared to diluted loss per share of $0.34 in the prior year; non-GAAP adjusted diluted earnings per share of $0.16 compared to non-GAAP diluted loss per share of $0.03 in the prior year

tjx_fy27_outlook.text: First Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2027 Outlook For the first quarter of Fiscal 2027, the Company is planning consolidated comparable sales to be up 2% to 3%, pretax profit margin to be in the range of 10.3% to 10.4%, and diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $.97 to $.99. For the full year Fiscal 2027, the Company is plann ing consolidated comparable sales to be up 2% to 3%, pretax profit margin to be in the range of 11.7% to 11.8%, and diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $4.93 to $5.02.
